title: Probably one of the weirdest dreams, that I’ve had.
content: So to start this,( I’m gonna use letters to help make it easy whos what) I was invited by 3 girls to an college football game, I went to HS with two of them( which I’ve never really talked to) and the other girl was random. We all drive there together. One of them was getting yelled at by someone so I stepped in to protect A. She gets upset and when we get to the house that we are staying at, she ended up staying in another apartment while me and the other one go to the main one. Girl B and myself end up going to the pool and as she starts leaving the pool, Girl B turns on Girl C she ended up drinking and getting drunk, as I’m leaving the pool, I get Teleported to my house where Girl C is sleeping. I leave the house for a little and I end up showing up to an Red Robin where as I was leaving, I saw Girl C coming inside with cuts on her face. She tells me that she’s not going back up and I let her know that I’m glad she’s okay and I start heading back up. The last thing that I remember is sending a text to one of the girls saying that I’m heading back up. So this is my first big post and I’m using mobile so I do apologize if it doesn’t make sense.
